Daniel Ari Friedman, PhD

I study how systems make sense of the world, from harvester ant colonies to Active Inference models and information ecosystems. I build open-source research tools, teach biology, and draw in pen and ink.

Research website · Search · Publications · Software · CV

Research domains · Featured projects · Interactive tools · Reading trails · Teaching and media · Art · Sources and reuse

Start exploring

  • Start here offers guided routes into the research, writing, and tools.
  • Data catalog describes the public datasets, and exports links to the files for citation managers and analysis.

The public website brings together the bibliography, software, research media, and art. The paper folders retain per-work sources and documentation. The repository manuscript explains how the index is built and checked.

Anil Matcha

Building open-source generative AI tooling and apps, most of it powered by muapi.ai — one API for 250+ image, video, and audio models. Official muapi SDKs, CLI, and integrations live under the SamurAIGPT org; this account has the flagship open-source apps, model-specific wrappers, and awesome-lists.

Related Projects

  • MuAPI model playground — Try the image, video, and audio models used across this ecosystem.
  • MuAPI API quick start — Connect the SDKs, apps, and integrations to one generative-media API.

Flagship projects

Repo What it is
Open-Generative-AI Self-hosted, unrestricted AI image & video studio — 200+ models, no content filters, MIT licensed
awesome-generative-ai-apps 50+ open-source generative AI apps you can clone, deploy, and monetize — one-click Vercel deploy
ai-creator-academy Free curriculum for making money with generative AI image, video, and audio
Open-AI-Design-Agent Autonomous creative agent for posters, social, brand kits, and video — alternative to Lovart/Runway Agent
Open-AI-UGC Generate AI UGC video ads with realistic AI actors (Veo 3.1, Seedance 2, Grok Video)
Open-AI-Micro-Drama-Generator Idea → complete short-form drama via a multi-agent pipeline (screenwriter → storyboard → frames → video)
Free-AI-Social-Media-Scheduler Self-hostable Postiz/Buffer/Hootsuite alternative with built-in AI content generation

Model wrappers & API docs

Video & content generation

  • AI-Voice-Agent — self-hosted AI voice agent
  • ai-clipping-comfyui — Opus Clip alternative for ComfyUI

Other apps

  • open-character-ai — Character.AI alternative
